name: solana-mcp-vybe
description: Live Solana market, token, wallet, and API tools from Vybe.

interface.shortDescription: Explore live Solana tokens, traders, markets, and wallets.
interface.longDescription:
Solana MCP by Vybe connects Codex to Vybe’s live Solana data and API toolkit: wallets, trades, markets, PnL, transfers, on-chain activity, and signable swaps. Ask for a wallet’s balances, realized and unrealized PnL, counterparties, or token holdings; look up token prices, holders, liquidity, and candles; scan markets, DEX activity, trade history, and transfers; or pull top traders and labeled accounts without leaving Codex.

Each tool calls one Vybe API endpoint. build-swap, build-close-token-accounts, and build-withdraw-mev return an unsigned payload for the user to sign in their own wallet.
